config.markdown:
### Logs
Three-part workflow: **1. Log Overview** for health and volume, **2. Log Search & Exploration** for full-text investigation and filters, and **3. Live Log Streaming** for real-time monitoring. HyperDX search provides the query builder, saved searches, bookmarks/favorites, export, and log-to-trace correlation.

#### 1. Log Overview
High-level log health and volume: totals, logs/sec, error/fatal share, severity, and service trends.

tiles.name: Error & fatal log count over time, by service

config.markdown:
#### 2. Log Search & Exploration
Use the search workspace below for full-text queries and filter by service, host, namespace, pod, severity, or time. Click grouped rows to open matching logs; use native HyperDX saved searches, bookmarks/favorites, exports, and correlation actions.

tiles.name: Top error signatures (normalized) - click a row to open Logs

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT ServiceName AS "Service", pattern AS "Signature", count() AS "Count" FROM (
  SELECT ServiceName,
         replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(Body, '[0-9a-fA-F-]{8,}', '<id>'), '[0-9]+', '<n>') AS pattern
  FROM {{LOGS_SCHEMA}}.{{LOGS_TABLE}}
  WHERE (SeverityNumber >= 17 OR lower(SeverityText) IN ('error', 'fatal'))
    AND Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64})
    AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64})
    AND $__filters
)
GROUP BY ServiceName, pattern
ORDER BY count() DESC
LIMIT 50

tiles.name: Errors & fatals by service (last 24h) - click a row to open Logs

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT ServiceName AS "Service",
       countIf(SeverityNumber = 17 OR lower(SeverityText) = 'error') AS "Errors",
       countIf(SeverityNumber = 21 OR lower(SeverityText) = 'fatal') AS "Fatal",
       max(Timestamp) AS "Last seen"
FROM {{LOGS_SCHEMA}}.{{LOGS_TABLE}}
WHERE (SeverityNumber >= 17 OR lower(SeverityText) IN ('error','fatal'))
  AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND $__filters
GROUP BY ServiceName
ORDER BY "Errors" + "Fatal" DESC
LIMIT 50

config.markdown:
#### 3. Live Log Streaming
Real-time monitoring for all logs and the focused error stream. Pause/resume and open any row for full details in HyperDX.

tiles.name: Live error stream - click a row for full log detail

config.select: Timestamp, SeverityText, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'], Body

tiles.name: Top Kubernetes error sources (namespace / pod) - click a row to open Logs

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS "Namespace", ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS "Pod", ServiceName AS "Service", count() AS "Errors"
FROM {{LOGS_SCHEMA}}.{{LOGS_TABLE}}
WHERE (SeverityNumber >= 17 OR lower(SeverityText) IN ('error', 'fatal'))
  AND Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64})
  AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64})
  AND $__filters
GROUP BY "Namespace", "Pod", ServiceName
ORDER BY count() DESC
LIMIT 50

onClick.whereTemplate: ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = '{{Namespace}}' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] = '{{Pod}}' AND ServiceName = '{{Service}}' AND (SeverityNumber >= 17 OR lower(SeverityText) IN ('error','fatal'))

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT count() / greatest(({endDateMilliseconds:Int64} - {startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) / 1000, 1) AS "Logs / sec" FROM {{LOGS_SCHEMA}}.{{LOGS_TABLE}} WHERE Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND $__filters

SELECT countIf(SeverityNumber >= 17 OR lower(SeverityText) IN ('error','fatal')) / greatest(({endDateMilliseconds:Int64} - {startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) / 1000, 1) AS "Errors / sec" FROM {{LOGS_SCHEMA}}.{{LOGS_TABLE}} WHERE Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND $__filters

SELECT countIf(SeverityNumber >= 17 OR lower(SeverityText) IN ('error','fatal')) / nullIf(count(), 0) AS "Error share" FROM {{LOGS_SCHEMA}}.{{LOGS_TABLE}} WHERE Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND $__filters

SELECT countIf(SeverityNumber >= 21 OR lower(SeverityText) = 'fatal') AS "Fatal logs" FROM {{LOGS_SCHEMA}}.{{LOGS_TABLE}} WHERE Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND $__filters

tiles.name: New error patterns in the past 24h

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT ServiceName AS Service, signature AS "New signature", count() AS Occurrences, min(Timestamp) AS "First seen", max(Timestamp) AS "Last seen" FROM (SELECT Timestamp, ServiceName, replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(Body, '[0-9a-fA-F-]{8,}', '<id>'), '[0-9]+', '<n>') AS signature FROM {{LOGS_SCHEMA}}.{{LOGS_TABLE}} WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 8 DAY AND (SeverityNumber >= 17 OR lower(SeverityText) IN ('error','fatal')) AND $__filters) GROUP BY ServiceName, signature HAVING "First seen" >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR ORDER BY Occurrences DESC LIMIT 100
